item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossless)】ALAC - EJAE - KPop Demon Hunters: EJAE's Demos
item.description:
KPop Demon Hunters: EJAE's Demos


Helloo! This is a all 5 of the demos shared by EJAE (Rumi's voice actress) on Daniel Wall's podcast "Behind The Wall" (Link for the interview is right HERE). I have tried my best to enhance the audios since they were played from EJAE's phone and due to that the quality isn't the best and im very sorry for that. I also created a little artwork for it. I hope u enjoy! <3
1. How It's Done (Final Demo)
2. How It's Done (First Demo)
3. Your Idol (First Demo)
4. Your Idol (Redone Intro)
5. What It Sounds Like (Final Medley Version)
